gameoverse_controller_plus.title: Gameoverse Controller Plus
gameoverse_controller_plus.binding.open_: Opens the hold, multi-tap and layer bind settings.
gameoverse_controller_plus.config.title: Gameoverse Controller Plus
gameoverse_controller_plus.config.intro: Adds hold, multi-tap and button-combination binds on top of Controlify. They work in game with no screen open, or, for binds set to Inventory Screens, in inventories and JEI's recipe screen. A button only waits to decide what you meant if it has one of these binds.
gameoverse_controller_plus.config.enable: Turns every advanced bind on or off.
gameoverse_controller_plus.config.rumble: A short rumble when a hold or multi-tap bind fires.
gameoverse_controller_plus.config.stick_: With the virtual cursor on, the right stick scrolls in whole mouse wheel steps in screens that ignore Controlify's smooth scrolling or turn a page on every frame of it: the Gameoverse Guide, Field Guide, Scholar books, the world map zoom, Ponder, Create value boards and JEI's recipe screen. Push further to scroll faster. Off gives those screens Controlify's own scrolling back.
gameoverse_controller_plus.config.scope_: Controlify's own light rumble for as long as a spyglass is up. Off by default: it never stops while you look through it.
gameoverse_controller_plus.config.modifi: A layer button (LB, RB) released within this time, without pressing a button of its layer, still does its normal action. Held longer, it does nothing.
Replaces your bind list with the default layout. Save to keep it. With the default layout you also get future changes to it.
gameoverse_controller_plus.config.binds_: Each bind: a trigger, the action it runs and how. Settings a trigger type doesn't use are ignored.
gameoverse_controller_plus.config.add.de: Adds a new bind at the end of the list.
gameoverse_controller_plus.config.bind.c: In Game: in the world with no screen open. Inventory Screens: inventories, containers and JEI's recipe screen, while no text field is focused; only the buttons these binds use are taken from Controlify's screen actions. JEI Recipe Screen: only there. Scoped binds are always in game.
gameoverse_controller_plus.config.bind.t: Tap: a short press. Hold: held for a time. Multi-tap: pressed several times quickly. Layer: pressed while the modifier button is held. Chord: both buttons held together, either order. Scoped: pressed while looking through a spyglass or zoom; the button does nothing else while scoped (Repeat mode repeats while held).
gameoverse_controller_plus.config.bind.b: The button. For a layer, the button pressed while the modifier is held. For a chord, the first of the two.
gameoverse_controller_plus.config.bind.m: Layer: the button held first. Chord: the second button. Other triggers ignore it.
Hold: how long to hold before the action runs. A shorter press does the button's tap action. Scoped in Repeat mode: how long to hold before the action starts repeating.
gameoverse_controller_plus.config.bind.w: Multi-tap: the longest gap between presses. A single tap on this button waits this long before it runs. Scoped, and the Repeat mode: the time between repeats.
gameoverse_controller_plus.config.bind.a: Any Controlify binding id (controlify:..., or controlify_modded:<key name> for another mod's key), gameoverse_controller_plus:spell_slot_N for the N-th spell on your spell bar that isn't on the use trigger, scroll_up / scroll_down for one mouse wheel step, drop_one to drop one item from the held stack, astronomy_mode / astronomy_use / astronomy_info for Spyglass Astronomy, or gameoverse_controller_plus:key_press/<key name> to press a key in a screen (for example key.jei.showRecipe).
gameoverse_controller_plus.config.bind.m: Press: a short press. Hold While: held down for as long as the trigger button stays held (charged spells, zoom). Toggle: each trigger switches it between held and released. Repeat: a press, then another every Tap Window while the trigger button stays held.
